reuse.why: Plugs the rule into the existing shouldFillCategory/filterFillCategories selection, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the shared tag helpers in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), which define how tags are delimited and escaped.

duplication.why: The rule itself is written once; the group-notes join is added to both getBudgetData and getFillCategories (unavoidable with two queries) and the tag regex restates tag parsing that already exists.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in the shared fill-category predicate in budget/actions.ts next to the template and hidden rules.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two queries feeding it, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and covers every month-wide action, but a private tag regex can drift from the app's tag semantics (e.g. ## escaping).

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts uses /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's regex is a reshaped version of the tag matching in shared/tags.ts

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts, used via filterFillCategories by copyPreviousMonth and via getFillCategories by setZero and the average actions
